gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states the patient's name and DOB; no generated fact mentions Jack Smith's DOB or explicitly identifies him in Social/Family History. HPI hpi-001 mentions the name but not the birth date or that specific social/family context.
Gold: 6-week history of difficulty hearing in the left ear. Generated hpi-001: Jack Smith reports difficulty hearing in his left ear over the past six weeks. Content and laterality align.

Gold includes intermittent tinnitus and slight nausea/dizziness together as associated symptoms. Generated facts separate tinnitus and dizziness but do not mention nausea at all, and do not explicitly say tinnitus is associated with the past 6 weeks. So the combined association (including nausea) is not fully captured.

Gold notes one previous similar episode that resolved spontaneously. Generated pmh-001 describes an intermittent hearing problem about a year ago lasting a few days but does not state explicitly that it resolved spontaneously or that it was similar to the current episode. Thus the similarity and spontaneous resolution are not clearly captured.

Gold: no ear discharge, fever, itchiness, or pain. Generated ros-003 (no ear pain), ros-004 (no ear discharge), ros-006 (no reported fever) cover three of these items. Itchiness is not mentioned, but the majority of the combined statement is present. Overall the denial of discharge, fever, and pain is captured; itchiness is omitted as a detail but does not negate coverage of the portion present.
Gold explicitly states the patient does not use cotton wool buds. No generated fact addresses cotton wool bud/Q-tip use.

Gold: No past medical history of note. Generated pmh-001 instead introduces a past intermittent hearing problem and does not state that overall PMH is unremarkable. Thus the gold assertion of no PMH of note is not captured.

Gold: on exam, looks well and not in pain. Generated physical findings only state that vitals, physical exam, and diagnostics are not documented; they do not record the observation that the patient looks well and not in pain.

Gold impression: need to exclude impacted wax in ear canal first. Generated asm-002 lists impacted earwax as a differential; plan-002 explicitly says to exclude earwax impaction as the cause. The intent to exclude impacted wax is clearly captured.

Gold: face-to-face GP appointment in 5 days to examine the ear. Generated plan-001: schedule a face-to-face appointment in the next 4–5 days to examine the ear; plan-005: book into a clinic for ear examination. This covers the planned face-to-face visit in approximately 5 days for ear exam.

Gold: advised to read about tinnitus via provided link. Generated plan-003: provide educational material on tinnitus; plan-004: encourage reading the leaflet to understand tinnitus before the next appointment. While the web link is not repeated, the substantive plan to read about tinnitus is captured.

Gold: patient advised to call back in the interim if any problems arise. Generated plan-007 advises booking another video appointment if symptoms worsen; fu-001 describes routine follow-up vs emergency. Neither explicitly captures the instruction to call back in the interim for any problems (not limited to worsening nor restricted to video appointment).

gen_assessment.reasoning: Chief complaint of a hearing problem is not explicitly stated in any gold fact, though it is consistent with the HPI. No direct gold support.
Matches gold hpi-001: difficulty hearing in the left ear for six weeks.
Describes hearing as deteriorating; gold only notes difficulty hearing without qualifying progression. This is extra detail not found in gold, not contradicted.

Gold hpi-002 includes intermittent tinnitus and no discharge or pain (hpi-004). Generated fact notes occasional ringing (tinnitus) in the left ear without discharge or pain, which aligns with these gold elements.
Gold notes intermittent tinnitus and symptoms, but does not say they are triggered by watching TV or listening to music. The trigger detail is new and not present in gold.
Gold mentions slight nausea/dizziness. Generated fact describes occasional dizziness as feeling off balance rather than spinning. This further characterizes the dizziness and is consistent with gold.

Gold pmh-001 states no past medical history of note. Generated pmh-001 introduces an intermittent hearing problem about a year ago lasting a few days, which is a notable past issue. This conflicts with the assertion of no PMH of note.
Gold does not mention medications. Stating that no current medications are documented is new information, neither supported nor refuted by gold.
Gold does not address allergies at all. The statement that allergies are not documented is additional.
Gold does not mention family history. Saying it is not documented is additional.
Gold social history only contains name/DOB; no mention of tobacco, alcohol, or substance use. Generated statement that this is not documented is extra.
Gold notes an exam impression (looks well, not in pain) but does not mention vitals documentation. Claim that vitals are not documented is new and unsupported in gold.
Gold pe-001 documents a physical exam finding (looks well, not in pain). Generated pe-002 states no physical examination findings are documented, which directly conflicts.
Gold does not mention any diagnostics. Claim that no diagnostic tests were performed is additional information.

Gold hpi-002 notes intermittent tinnitus (implied in the left ear because hearing issues are left-sided). Generated ros-001 states tinnitus in the left ear, which is consistent and more specific laterality.
Gold hpi-001: difficulty hearing in the left ear. Generated ros-002: decreased hearing in the left ear only. This is consistent with gold.
Gold hpi-004: patient denies pain. Generated ros-003: he has no ear pain. Directly aligned.
Gold hpi-004 denies ear discharge. Generated ros-004: no ear discharge. Directly aligned.
Gold hpi-002 includes slight nausea/dizziness. Generated ros-005: episodes of dizziness. This is consistent (possibly more frequent) but not contradictory.
Gold hpi-004: no fever. Generated ros-006: no reported fever. Directly consistent.
Gold facts do not mention chest pain. Statement that he has no chest pain is additional.
Gold facts do not mention palpitations. Statement that he has no palpitations is additional.
Gold hpi-001 and hpi-002 describe six-week history of left-ear hearing difficulty with tinnitus and dizziness. Generated asm-001 summarizes this as the assessment, which is consistent.

Gold asm-001 emphasizes the need to exclude impacted wax. Generated asm-002 includes impacted earwax as a differential and adds other differentials (otitis media, inner ear pathology) that are not refuted by gold. Overall it is consistent and extends the differential.
Gold notes intermittent tinnitus but does not state it is potentially related to specific activities. The characterization of tinnitus as related to specific activities is additional detail.
Gold does not explicitly classify the disposition as routine or non-emergent. Calling it routine follow-up and not an emergency is additional, though clinically plausible.

Gold plan-001: face-to-face GP appointment in 5 days to examine ear. Generated plan-001: schedule face-to-face appointment in next 4–5 days to examine ear for wax or blockage. This matches the timing and purpose.
Gold asm-001: need to exclude impacted wax in ear canal first. Generated plan-002: exclude earwax impaction as cause of hearing difficulty. Same intent.
Gold plan-002: patient to read about tinnitus via a link. Generated plan-003: provide educational material on tinnitus. Both describe education on tinnitus; gold is more specific (link).

Gold plan-002 requires reading about tinnitus in the meantime. Generated plan-004 encourages reading tinnitus leaflet to understand causes and options before next appointment. This is consistent elaboration of the same instruction.
Gold plan-001: face-to-face GP appointment to examine ear. Generated plan-005: book into a clinic for ear examination. This restates the same plan.
Gold specifies that the patient will have a GP appointment but does not say who schedules or how. Advising calling the support team to schedule is additional process detail.

Gold follow-up instruction is to ring back if any problems in the interim (fu-001). Generated plan-007 specifies booking another video appointment if symptoms worsen. This is different in modality and narrower in scope and thus best classified as additional rather than directly supported. It does not directly contradict the concept of contacting providers for problems, but it is not in the gold text.

Gold fu-001 describes interim call-back for problems but does not use the term routine follow-up vs emergency. Generated fu-001 explicitly labels disposition as routine and not emergency, which is additional classification not present in gold.
